title: Basic Automation Training
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Basic Automation Training Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Convert between decimal, binary, and hexadecimal numbers for addressing and other operations typical of controllers and communication devices.

Select and install the proper sensor for different sensing applications, integrating them into basic controllers to achieve basic automatic control functions for temperature, flow, pressure, weight, and other process variables.
Write and demonstrate a simple PLC program to accomplish a given logic task, being able to investigate and determine the location of faults in a Programmable Logic Controller system.
careers: entry-level positions in instrumentation or process control departments

notes: The catalog prints course codes without a space (ELTEC221, ELTEC212, ELTEC232); these match closed-list ELTEC 221, ELTEC 212, ELTEC 232.

The page prints an extra outcomes lead-in ('Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:') after the description with no outcomes under it; the outcomes were taken from the Program Learning Outcomes heading.
The outer 'Basic Automation Training (Total 9)' wrapper contains only the REQUIRED COURSES group, recorded as one block.

Career entry taken from the description; 'technical field positions' describes the intended students' current roles and 'Electrical Trainees' refers to apprenticeship training, so neither was recorded as a career.
